blind.description: A stylized weathered stone bench consisting of a thick rectangular top slab resting on two squat, pillar-style stone supports with arched relief carvings. The material has a warm sandstone/tan appearance textured with mossy green patches and minor chiseled notches. The mesh is fully solid and continuous, sitting directly and flatly on the floor with no floating geometry, melted regions, or glows.
blind.from_above: A simple elongated rectangle with softly rounded corners, transverse seam grooves separating the end caps, and a mottled tan stone surface dappled with green moss.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 1/3 to 1/4 the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (about 1.5 to 1.8 ft tall); about 4 to 5 ft in length and 1.5 ft in depth.
